COD.note: Programme is for young people, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The government said on 16 February 2026 it had completed the first train-the-trainer phase in Kinshasa, with 500 trainees and 200 to be selected as trainers, as part of a national plan to train 250,000 young people, with rollout to the provinces next.
